newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Pearson raised at BZW.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pearson raised at BZW.

text.p: British media and leisure group Pearson Plc was raised to a "buy" from "hold" at BZW, market sources said on Tuesday.
The move came after chief executive Marjorie Scardino took office last week amid hopes she would focus more on shareholder value and drive through disposals to focus on Pearson's core business.
BZW analysts expect earnings at Pearson to grow 27 percent in 1998 after a rise of nine percent in 1997 as the group benefits from restructuring measures, sources said.
BZW analysts reportedly said that once Pearson's stakes in BSkyB and Channel 5 were stripped out, its core businesses were trading on a multiple of just 14.6 times expected 1998 earnings.
This is a 13 percent premium to the rest of the market and makes it one of the cheapest of major media stocks, according to BZW.
BZW set a price target of 838p on the stock, 11 percent above its present level.
The stock was up 1p at 757-1/2 by 1437 GMT.
